---
title: "The Political Economy of RMBS Intervention"
date: "2008-09-30"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

I have an [op-ed](http://business.theage.com.au/business/4-billion-is-no-real-help-20080929-4qfy.html?page=1 "op-ed") in today’s *Age* on the politics behind the government’s intervention in the market for residential mortgage-backed securities.

It was pleasing to see the *Australian Financial Review* take a strong editorial stance against the intervention (‘Swan Banks on a Very Bad Idea,’ *AFR*, 29 September 2008, p. 62).  The *AFR* attributed the very transparent politics behind the intervention ‘to the *Hollowmen* school of policymaking.’
